name: Management UI Community Plugin Registry
description: Registry for community-developed plugins. In development, this file is used when present. In production, the Marketplace fetches from the configured registry URL(s). Entries whose id starts with 'demo-' are catalog-only showcase data for developing the marketplace UI — their bundle URLs are intentionally not loadable.

plugins.name: Trial Demo (Local Dev)
plugins.description: Local test bundle for the Try gesture, served by plugins/admin-marketplace-v2/dev/stub-backend.mjs (see that plugin's README).
plugins.tagline: Ephemeral test plugin served by the local stub backend.

plugins.name: Audience Poll (Local Dev)
plugins.description: Local development build of the Audience Poll plugin.
plugins.tagline: Slide-synced live polls your viewers answer from any device.

plugins.name: Auto Captions
plugins.description: Every processed recording gets a caption track automatically. A side-by-side editor lets staff correct the transcript with a keyboard-only flow, and one click publishes it to the player. Supports per-series glossaries for domain vocabulary.
plugins.tagline: Speech-to-text on every upload — edit, translate, publish.

plugins.name: Viewer Analytics
plugins.description: A dashboard that answers the questions people actually ask: which recordings get watched, how far viewers get, and when engagement drops off. All data is aggregated and anonymized on ingestion — no individual viewer tracking, ever.
plugins.tagline: Who watched what, and where they stopped. Privacy-first.

plugins.name: Quiz Overlays
plugins.description: Embed multiple-choice checkpoints at any timestamp. Playback pauses until the viewer answers, and results export as CSV per series.
plugins.tagline: In-video checkpoints that pause playback until answered.

plugins.name: LMS Sync
plugins.description: Connects series to LMS courses over LTI 1.3. Enrollments drive permissions, and quiz results from compatible plugins flow back to the gradebook.
plugins.tagline: Series appear in your LMS courses automatically.

plugins.name: Speech Search
plugins.description: Full-text search across every transcript in your library. Results deep-link to the exact second the phrase is spoken.
plugins.tagline: Search the spoken word, jump straight to the moment.

plugins.name: Slide Detection
plugins.description: Computer vision over the presentation track detects slide transitions and generates a navigable chapter list — plus OCR'd slide text feeding into search.
plugins.tagline: Finds slide changes and builds chapter markers from them.

plugins.name: Midnight
plugins.description: Restyles the whole interface for dark environments: dimmed chrome, high-contrast focus states, and player controls that don't glow in a dark room.
plugins.tagline: A deep-blue dark theme tuned for control-room lighting.

plugins.name: Meadow
plugins.description: Bright surfaces, soft shadows, and a green accent — designed for daylight offices and projector demos.
plugins.tagline: A light, friendly theme with generous contrast.
